data.value: Still unsure? Ask us with the Help button.

data.name: Home.Faq.Free.Q
data.value: Can I really try it for free?

data.name: Home.Faq.Free.A
data.value: Yes. Every paid exam has 30 trial questions you can start right away without an account, with explanations. Free exams open in full once you sign up.

data.name: Home.Faq.Account.A
data.value: Not for trial questions. Sign up free to keep your results, open free exams and use flashcards. Trial results you already have move to your new account.

data.name: Home.Faq.Pay.A
data.value: Choose an exam or a subscription package, then pay by QRIS or virtual account. The available methods are shown on the payment page, and access opens once the payment is received.

data.name: Home.Faq.Access.Q
data.value: How long does my access last?

data.name: Home.Faq.Access.A
data.value: Each exam has its own access period, shown on the exam page before you pay. A subscription opens every exam in the catalog for the whole period.

data.name: Home.Faq.Official.Q
data.value: Is this an official BKN or government app?

data.name: Home.Faq.Official.A
data.value: No. LatihanSoal is an independent practice app and is not affiliated with BKN, BUMN, the service schools or the UKMPPD organisers.

data.name: Home.Faq.Signal.Q
data.value: Does it work on a weak signal?

data.name: Home.Faq.Signal.A
data.value: Yes. The pages are light, and each answer is saved when you pick it, so a short drop in signal does not wipe your progress.

data.name: Home.Faq.WrongKey.Q
data.value: What if an answer key is wrong?

data.name: Home.Faq.WrongKey.A
data.value: Tap Report this question on the review page. Our team checks reports question by question and fixes them.

data.name: Home.Faq.Own.Q
data.value: Can I write my own questions?

data.name: Home.Faq.Own.A
data.value: Yes. Once you sign up you can write your own questions and exams, practise them and share the link with friends.
